_comments: Default list for Payment Webhook Deliveries (#474): deliveries Orders did not apply, so a payment taken
outside the checkout or an unreadable event is visible. Events of a kind Orders does not act on
(kind_not_handled) are left out: the gateway account sends many of those and none needs attention.
Applied and AlreadyApplied deliveries are normal and also left out; clear the filter to see every row.

fields.Name: Payment Webhook Deliveries: Not Applied
fields.Description: Verified gateway webhook deliveries Orders ignored, rejected or failed to apply, newest first. Event kinds Orders does not act on are left out.
fields.WhereClause: Outcome IN ('Ignored','Rejected','Failed') AND (ReasonCode IS NULL OR ReasonCode <> 'kind_not_handled')
